original.title: Clique-root conjecture for l-connected chordal K(l+3)-free graphs
original.statement:
Let $l$ be a positive integer, and let $G$ be an $l$-connected chordal graph. Let $K_{l+3}$ denote the complete graph on $l+3$ vertices. A **clique root** is a real root of the clique polynomial $C(G,x)$.

**Clique-root conjecture.** If $G$ is $K_{l+3}$-free, then $G$ has only clique roots.

This is presented as a stronger conjecture extending the preceding claims for restricted connectivity and clique-exclusion classes. The source does not state whether it has been resolved.
original.source_name: Hossein Teimoori Faal, “Sums of Polynomials and Clique Roots”, arXiv:2112.09744 (2021).
original.references:
**2 papers in this index state this conjecture** (2021). The statement above is taken from the most recent of them; the others are [arXiv:2112.09721](https://arxiv.org/abs/2112.09721).

Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2112.09744

Status: **open** according to the source (as of December 2021). “Based on Proposition , the following open question naturally arises.”
